transcript: The Long Winter Ended The long winter ended, the snow melted The fields and hills gradually recovered The earth was awake, the air felt pleasant Cherry trees were full of flowers As I walked along the river, my heart became calm My face grew gentle, the world itself seemed new On the path I met a friend She looked more mature than last year Yet her smile remained the same Her eyes shone brightly, her voice sounded warm Children's voices reached me And I felt full of pleasure and delight A fresh hope rose in my heart A small joy emerged in my chest at night I remained awake Everything was quietly but surely becoming new The spring was young the world seemed alive

segments.text: The long winter ended, the snow melted
The fields and hills gradually recovered
The earth was awake, the air felt pleasant
Cherry trees were full of flowers
As I walked along the river, my heart became calm
My face grew gentle, the world itself seemed new
On the path I met a friend
She looked more mature than last year
Yet her smile remained the same
Her eyes shone brightly, her voice sounded warm
And I felt full of pleasure and delight
A fresh hope rose in my heart
A small joy emerged in my chest at night
Everything was quietly but surely becoming new
